name: Tone of Voice Guidelines
tagline: Complete 30-page Tone of Voice Guidelines display system with its own typography, composition and layout vocabulary.

palette.description: Source-specific colors retained in native text, shapes, tables and image treatments; not normalized across templates.

typography.style: DM Serif Display display with Inter body; original source font-family roles, declared weights, sizes and frames retained. Original unmodified font files are embedded with their own licenses; font versions are recorded. No common font substitution.

best_for: Brand voice and tone, writing principles, product language, customer-support examples and channel-specific communication guidelines.
avoid_for: Chart-heavy financial reporting, technical architecture documentation, or stories requiring large photo portfolios.
